infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Craft Mastery uses your camera so you can take photos of your handmade crafts for listings.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Craft Mastery uses your photo library so you can select photos of your handcrafted products.
